subject: physics

hotspots.label: Cart
hotspots.description: The cart moving along the track, its velocity controlled by the gas and brake.
hotspots.positionHint: A small rounded cart on the straight mat.
hotspots.function: Carries the object whose velocity changes.

hotspots.label: Gas Control
hotspots.description: Press to make the cart speed up — a positive acceleration and an upward-sloping velocity-time line.
hotspots.positionHint: A raised push-pedal near the track edge.
hotspots.function: Applies positive acceleration to the cart.

hotspots.label: Brake Control
hotspots.description: Press to slow the cart — a negative acceleration and a line that dips downward.
hotspots.positionHint: A red pedal beside the gas pedal.

hotspots.label: Velocity-Time Graph
hotspots.description: The live line of velocity against time; its slope is the acceleration — steep up means big positive, dipping down means negative.
hotspots.positionHint: Floating screen over the track drawing the cart's velocity.
hotspots.function: Shows how acceleration looks as slope on the velocity graph.

hotspots.label: Acceleration Readout
hotspots.description: The numeric acceleration in m/s², with its sign, computed live from the run.
hotspots.positionHint: A small badge with a signed number near the cart.
hotspots.function: Reads the m/s² value of the current acceleration.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper backdrop with soft vignette, no floor grid. A straight warm-grey track, amber cart, green gas pedal and coral brake pedal, floating velocity screen. Saturated color on pedals and readout dots only. Soft neutral studio light, no bloom, no emissive.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0. Track: warm-grey (roughness ~0.7). Cart: amber smooth body (roughness ~0.4). Pedals: soft sculpted plastic in muted green and coral (roughness ~0.5). Graph screen: paper white with dark ink axes. Number text runtime overlay.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: acceleration as the rate of change of velocity-on-a-straight-track, procedural to drive.

GEOMETRY: straight mat along +x (length ~7), cart near origin, two pedals slightly ahead, floating graph screen overhead (0, 1.2, 0.5).

INTERACTION: Gas applies a positive constant a; idle drops a to zero; Brake clamps a negative. The app computes velocity = integral of acceleration each frame and strokes the graph so its slope is the live a. Support 0→1.5× for 'turn it steep'.

LAYERS: track+cart; controls; graph; readout plate.

NAMED NODES: TrackMat, Cart, GasPedal, BrakePedal, VelocityScreen, AccelPlate. 5-9k tris.
